result:
Summary: The HotpotQA original paper by Yang et al. (2018) reports retrieval performance in the full wiki setting with Hits@10 scores of 56.06 on the test set. The paper also mentions that BM25 was used as an IR system component in their experiments, achieving a MAP of 43.21 and a Hits@10 of 55.88. The Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) model, as described in the paper by Lee et al. (2019), outperforms BM25 significantly, achieving 66.8% in Top-5 accuracy compared to BM25's 42.9%.
